units.translation: a nurse of the newly sown wave

The inferior form is νοσσός [chick], noted by Phrynichus Ecl. p. 206: on which see Thes. vol. 5 p. 1572. Aeschylus used it once, no doubt for metrical reasons, which Antiatt. noted in Bekk. Anecd. p. 109, 22 νοσσόν χωρίς τοῦ ε Αἰσχύλος Κήρυξιν [chick without the epsilon, Aeschylus in the Heralds] (fr. 110).
he will shut them in like a fierce serpent from the chicks

new, with a sense of unexpected
